अरे भाई! पर्दे पर जितने कूल दिखते हैं टॉम हॉलैंड, असली जिंदगी में स्पाइडर-मैन सूट पहनकर उनकी उतनी ही लंका लगती है! 🕷️

MCU में 2016 से धमाकेदार एंट्री करने वाले टॉम हॉलैंड ने NBC के शो Late Night With Seth Meyers में अपनी इस दर्दभری कहानी का खुलासा किया है। 🎬

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, सिर से पैर तक टाइट Lycra सूट पहनने की वजह से वह शूटिंग के दौरान अपना स्मार्टफोन तक साथ नहीं रख पाते थे। 📱

टीनएज में फोन की लत के चलते टॉम ने नाक से ही सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट लाइक करने का नायाब हुनर सीख लिया था, क्योंकि सूट में खुजली करना भी नामुमकिन था! 😂

पानी पीने के लिए उन्हें सूट की आंखें निकालनी पड़ती थीं और स्ट्रॉ डालनी पड़ती थी, जबकि स्नैक्स खाने के लिए वह मास्क थोड़ा आगे खिसका लेते थे। 🥤

टॉम का यह भी कहना है कि स्मूथ लुक के लिए उन्हें पहले दिन से ही थोंग्स पहनने पड़ते हैं, जो उनके लिए काफी असहज था। 🩲

वाशरूम जाने की समस्या का तो कोई पक्का हल ही नहीं है, इसलिए उन्हें हर 45 मिनट में अपने बाथरूम ब्रेक प्लान करने पड़ते हैं क्योंकि पूरा कॉस्ट्यूम खोलना पड़ता है। 🚽

इन तमाम परेशानियों के बावजूद टॉम इस बात से संतुष्ट हैं और वह किसी भी आसान रोल के मुकाबले इन्हीं मुश्किलों को चुनना पसंद करेंगे!

ctx.title: Tom Holland Has A Love-Hate Relationship With His Spider-Man Suit & His Reasons Are Surprisingly Specific
ctx.summary:
Tom Holland finally opened up about the frustrating aspects of his Spider-Man suit, and his reasons might change how you see the costume. 
 The post  Tom Holland Has A Love-Hate Relationship With His Spider-Man Suit & His Reasons Are Surprisingly Specific  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Tom Holland surely looks very handsome in his Spider-Man suit, and it looks incredibly cool onscreen too. But who knew that wearing the iconic red and blue suit is a very different experience, and it’s not good at all.
Over the years, Tom Holland has revealed several uncomfortable experiences with his Spidey suit that have been real headaches for the actor.
Since making his MCU debut in 2016, we have seen Tom Holland flaunt several Spidey suits. So, what was so nightmarish about them? Tom Holland has opened up about the constant struggles and how he coped during his appearance on NBC’s Late Night With Seth Meyers. Let’s check it out.
If there’s one common thing about all the Spider-Man suits, it’s the fact that there’s almost no exposed skin once you wear the costume. So, from head to toe, the actor is covered in Lycra, which makes it very comfortable. The costume clung to his body so tightly that he couldn’t even carry a smartphone during the shoot.
As a teenager, Holland used his phone frequently and was constantly on social media. That’s why he developed a rather unusual skill of liking posts with his nose. Even scratching an itch became a very big deal for him in such a tight suit.
While these are still small problems, when it comes to eating or even drinking water, the challenge goes to the next level. The glass eyepieces on the Spider-Man suit are detachable, and Holland removes one to insert a straw and drink water. And when it comes to food, Holland pushes the mask slightly forward to push chewing gum and snacks through the hole.
As uncomfortable as the costume looks from outside, it’s equally frustrating from the inside. What Tom Holland wears underneath is worse. To get the smooth costume look, Holland has to wear thongs since the very first day. Even though he was quite uncomfortable with the idea initially, he had no choice.
The bigger problem comes when Holland has to go to the washroom. And there’s kind of no solution to it. That’s why he has to plan his bathroom breaks every 45 minutes because the whole costume has to be opened. Despite all the struggles, Holland is very satisfied with the outcome and would probably choose these struggles over easy roles any day.
